name: Solution Design
producesProse: Architecture doc, data model / schema designs, API specs, wireframes, job and storage design.

exitCriteria.describe: All requirements trace to a component.

purpose: Design a structure every requirement traces into, and settle the data model and the storage target.

method.summary: Design the components and the data model, then trace every requirement to a component.
steps: Read the approved requirements and the decisions Stage 4 recorded.
Delegate design work to the planning specialist where the structure is larger than this conversation.
Author the components, the data model, the API specs and the wireframes the requirements need.
Choose the storage target and record why.
Trace every requirement to the component that carries it, and check that none is left untraced.
Obtain the operator's approval of the data model and the design, then set the approved artifacts to approved.
Ask the operator to confirm the attestation, record an attestation against each exit criterion, then exit.

nextActivity.rule: Resolve a blocking question first; delegate to planning when the design needs specialist work; author or revise while any requirement is untraced or the storage target is unchosen; attest once every exit criterion holds; exit only after attestation.
constraints: A requirement with no component behind it is not designed for.
The storage target is chosen here, not deferred to implementation.

approvalBoundary.approves: The data model and the design, by the operator.
requires: The operator confirms the exact stage attestation or advance through Kiln's interactive confirmation channel during that invocation.

completionSummary.format: A concise Markdown handoff with bullets under Completed, Decisions, Open items, and Next activity.
includes: The components and how they fit together.
The data model and the storage target chosen.
